title: Foundations of Computer Science

gradingBreakdown.component: Course Evaluation and Computing CARES Surveys

workloadNotes: 12 weekly homework assignments (lowest 2 dropped, 4% each of final grade), one midterm (24%) and a cumulative final exam (32%); homework problems mix effort-based and regular (graded) problems. Late homework receives no credit. Collaboration encouraged on homework (must be disclosed) but not on exams.
textbooks: Michael Sipser, Introduction to the Theory of Computation, 2nd or 3rd ed. (recommended, not required)
Cris Moore and Stephan Mertens, The Nature of Computation (free online via U-M Library, recommended)
